title: PipeTargetRedshiftDataParameters
description: These are custom parameters to be used when the target is a Amazon Redshift cluster to invoke the Amazon Redshift Data API ExecuteStatement.

allOf.description: The name of the database. Required when authenticating using temporary credentials.
The database user name. Required when authenticating using temporary credentials.
The name or ARN of the secret that enables access to the database. Required when authenticating using SageMaker.
The SQL statement text to run.
The name of the SQL statement. You can name the SQL statement when you create it to identify the query.
Indicates whether to send an event back to EventBridge after the SQL statement runs.
